entities.name: Geoffrey I of Lusignan (Lord of Vouvant)

entities.summary: Geoffrey of Lusignan was the Lord of Vouvant and Soubise, and Count of Jaffa and Ascalon. He was also Lord of Mervent and Moncontour by his wife's rights.
